text:
Lior Beres thank you so much for all of the info, this is really really helpful.

I wasn’t entirely clear on what the lawyer was going into the office for either.. we went to see her after being turned away from Misrad Hapnim, just to enquire and seek guidance about the process. After an initial few questions, she took the file and went into them, came back and told us they were ‘reviewing our file’🤷‍♀️ I’m not sure if it was to clarify details for us (like the ID address etc) or for them to tell us if we were missing something before opening the actual application. Either way, it changed nothing around opening a file. The lawyer walking in was very helpful though and we got answers to some of the questions we had.
